summary: Full backend + frontend regression for POS Pro. 25/25 pytest backend cases pass. Frontend manager+worker flows verified end-to-end including auth, role-guarded routing, POS sale (manual barcode + click-to-add), reports tabs, notifications mark-all-read, sidebar/POS logout, bad-password error.

minor.issue: Returns {ok:true} with default 200; no UserOut schema - acceptable but inconsistent with create_user response model

backend/.env sets CORS_ORIGINS=* while allow_credentials=True. Browsers reject credentials with wildcard origin; works here only because Bearer-token fallback is also sent. Set FRONTEND_URL or comma-separated origins to be spec-compliant.

issues: Charge button shows muted color when cart total is 0 - acceptable. Layout responsive and clean.

verified_flows: POST /api/auth/login manager+worker (200, role correct)
POST /api/auth/login bad password (401)
GET /api/auth/me with Bearer token (200) and without (401)
GET /api/products lists 8 seeded items incl. Flat White Coffee
GET /api/products/by-barcode/9300000000017 returns Flat White Coffee (200); unknown -> 404
POST /api/products manager creates (201); worker forbidden (403)
POST /api/sales decrements stock, creates notification, computes total/profit (201)
POST /api/sales insufficient stock -> 400
POST /api/purchases manager increments stock (201); worker -> 403
POST /api/expenses manager (201); worker -> 403
GET /api/notifications + POST /api/notifications/read-all (all read after)
GET /api/reports/summary?period=day|month returns revenue/cogs/gross_profit/expenses/net_profit
GET /api/reports/timeseries?days=14 returns 14 buckets
GET /api/reports/daily-report returns top_products + recent_sales
POST /api/users manager creates worker; worker list /api/users -> 403
UI: Login prefills manager creds, manager submits -> /dashboard
UI: Worker login -> /pos; navigating to /dashboard redirects back to /pos
UI: POS shows 8 product cards, search filter narrows, click adds to cart, qty +/- works, checkout creates sale, receipt dialog shown, toast 'Sale recorded · $5.50'
UI: Scan modal opens with data-testid='manual-barcode-input' + 'manual-barcode-submit'; barcode 9300000000017 adds Flat White Coffee to cart
UI: Dashboard renders with $ amounts and chart
UI: Reports has Day/Month tabs and CSV export button; tabs switch correctly
UI: Notifications page lists alerts and mark-all-read button toggles disabled state after click
UI: Sidebar logout returns to /login; bad password shows inline error in [data-testid='login-error']
UI: All manager nav items (dashboard, products, purchases, expenses, users, reports, alerts) reachable
action_items: Optional: tighten CORS by setting FRONTEND_URL in backend/.env (currently allow_credentials=True with origins='*')
Cosmetic: nav label for Notifications page is 'Alerts' (data-testid=nav-alerts) - intentional but worth documenting
critical_code_review_comments: JWT_SECRET is committed in /app/backend/.env - acceptable for dev/preview only; rotate before prod.
Frontend stores JWT in localStorage (pos_token) AND backend sets httpOnly cookie. Dual mechanism works around third-party cookie restrictions but doubles attack surface for XSS.
seed_admin correctly re-hashes admin password if changed; bcrypt salts use $2b$ prefix (verified).
Backend excludes Mongo _id everywhere via projection - good.
POS sale endpoint races (not atomic) - two simultaneous sales could oversell. Not blocking for MVP.
Currency formatter uses en-AU; verified '$X.XX' displayed.
test_credentials: Manager: manager@store.com / manager123; Worker: worker@store.com / worker123
seed_data_creation: Backend auto-seeds admin + worker users and 8 sample products on startup; verified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: backend_test.py is pytest-style with class fixtures (manager_token, worker_token). Camera-mode of BarcodeDetector is browser-dependent; only manual barcode entry was tested per request. All data-testids in code: login-email, login-password, login-submit, login-error, nav-<lowercase_label> (notifications->nav-alerts), logout-btn (sidebar), pos-logout, pos-search, pos-scan-btn, product-card-<id>, qty-inc-/dec-/remove-<id>, payment-<method>, discount-input, cart-total, checkout-btn, receipt-dialog, receipt-close, manual-barcode-input, manual-barcode-submit, tab-day, tab-month, export-csv, mark-all-read, notification-<id>.
